source_item.title: German two-year yield near multi-week high ahead of ECB decision

card.plain_headline: German Yields Rise Ahead of ECB Rate Decision
card.what_happened: Yields on German two-year government bonds are approaching recent highs as investors anticipate the European Central Bank's (ECB) upcoming monetary policy decision. This suggests market participants are pricing in potential shifts in interest rate expectations.
card.what_happened_verbose: The interest rate on short-term German government debt, specifically the two-year bond yield, is climbing towards levels not seen in several weeks. This movement occurs just before the ECB is set to announce its latest policy decisions. Bond yields rise when prices fall, and falling prices often indicate that investors are selling bonds, perhaps in anticipation of higher interest rates or due to concerns about inflation. The ECB's decision could influence the future path of interest rates in the Eurozone.
